description: The carriers BerthTime knows: SCAC, name, which reference types each supports and whether tracking is live today. Use it to find the SCAC for track_shipment's `carrier` or to answer "do you support X". Optional: live_only (default false). Returns: carriers[] {scac, name, ref_types, tracking, ...}. No paging (the full list).

live_only.description: Only carriers with live tracking today.
